evidence.observation: Purge brought O2 down from about 28766 to 15 ppm; it stays at 3-6 ppm afterwards.
The ramp tracked setpoint within about 0.5 °C, except at 720 s where it lagged by about 10 °C and then caught up.
Overshoot of 761.4 °C at the start of growth (setpoint 750) is settling, now 752.5 °C; heater power dropped to about 40-42% for the hold, which fits.
Pressure is steady at about 760 Torr and Ar flow matches the 100 sccm setpoint.

args.missing_evidence: No characterization of the sample yet. Also, no reference ranges from normal runs were provided, so I can't compare the overshoot size to typical runs.
